description: This file defines the AttachmentSaver class responsible for handling file uploads, saving attachment metadata, and integrating with a repository. It manages file storage and creates Attachment objects with relevant info such as file hash, size, and mime type.

classes.name: AttachmentSaver
classes.description: Handles the process of uploading files, verifying directory permissions, creating attachments, and persisting them via a repository.

methods.name: uploadAttachment
methods.description: Uploads a file, stores its metadata in an Attachment object, and saves it through the repository. Ensures directory exists and is writable, moves the uploaded file, then gathers file info.
